items.reason: Verifier results write timestamped Markdown reports under the set’s verify directory.
Collision handling retains successive reports; report creation happens after agent fallback resolves.
The verdict-first contract remains, and the remaining reply becomes the report body.
Existing verdict parsing remains unchanged; malformed replies retain their raw text.
Report writing applies to all three agent verdicts.
The response contract explicitly requires PASS findings explaining checks and criterion satisfaction.
Cache hits return before report creation.
Invalidation deletes cached verdicts without touching report files.
Previous reports stay outside Verifier prompts; human-note forwarding remains unchanged.
Human acceptance writes a report without invoking an agent.
Human reports include the supplied rationale and overridden verdict.
Explicit authorship headers distinguish human and Verifier reports.
Human reports use the same directory, timestamp naming, shared header renderer, and latest-report lookup.
The gate preamble displays the latest report path and recorded commit facts without its prose.
The paging action opens the report and returns to the gate menu.
Task-set detail rendering includes the Verify report pointer.
Verify artifacts rank above Refine artifacts.
Agent prompt views gain no Verify pointer; only Verifier response-contract goldens change.
Missing reports produce no Verify preamble, paging entry, detail section, or artifact.
Verification badge and status derivation remain independent of report age.
Failed-status details retain first-line findings and append the report path.
Both passes share rendering, filing, timestamp scanning, header parsing, and pointer machinery.
Refine retains its existing directory, filename format, headers, and rendering.
Refiner prompt golden files are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared implementation with focused regression tests; persistence-failure handling and fallback report-count coverage could be stronger.
